title: Verify: Hover emits objectHover and SceneObject hover listener
summary: Unit tests for the SceneObject hover listener and BootScene objectHover emission
description: Tests with fake RenderContext and mocked Phaser.
acceptance_criteria: Hidden object produces no listener call

steps.action: Copy makeSpec and the fake RenderContext helper from game/tests/sceneObject.test.ts. Add test 'visible object reports hover in and out': register onHover spy, trigger captured handle hover callback with true then false, assert spy called with {objectId, over:true} then {objectId, over:false}. Add test 'hidden object reports nothing': sync a state failing visibleWhen, trigger hover true, assert spy not called.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneObjectHover.test.ts

steps.action: Reuse the vi.mock setup of bootSceneSync.test.ts but make the fake object's onHover a vi.fn. Subscribe to phaserToReact objectHover with a spy, call boot.create(), take the callback passed to fake.onHover, call it with {objectId:'bookshelf', over:true} then {objectId:'bookshelf', over:false}, assert spy payloads {id:'bookshelf'} then {id:null}.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneHover.test.ts
steps.expected: objectHover emitted with the id then null
